create_benchmark: create a logistic regression benchmark dataset with configurable samples, features, and random seed
run_dp_training: run differentially private logistic regression training with BandMF execution plan and SGD optimizer
audit_privacy: audit trained model privacy using canary score auditor with held-in and held-out canary sets
compute_elementwise_loss: compute element-wise logistic loss for individual data points given model parameters and features
configure_bandmf_plan: configure a BandMF execution plan with privacy budget, clipping norm, and batch selection strategy
